title: Kissed Smoky Venezuelan Potato Hash
description: A buttery and crispy Venezuelan dish featuring Yukon gold potatoes, perfect for a hangover cure, served on a traditional Talavera plate. This Whole30-friendly recipe combines smoky flavors with a satisfying crunch.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, toss the diced potatoes with smoked paprika, salt, black pepper, and garlic powder until they are evenly coated.
Heat 2 tablespoons of coconut oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the potato mixture, cooking for 5 minutes on each side or until they are golden brown.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes or until the potatoes are crispy.
While the potatoes are baking, melt 2 tablespoons of unsalted butter in a small saucepan over low heat.
Remove the skillet from the oven and brush the melted butter over the potatoes.
Return the skillet to the stovetop over medium heat and cook for an additional 5 minutes, stirring frequently, until the potatoes are crispy and golden brown.
Serve the potato hash on a traditional Talavera plate, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro.
